text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum~...♪
Is it time yet? Is it time yet...?♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho... Has that time of year come already—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kris S-san!
That's right, when you think of April, it's gotta be!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: People are saying there are a lot of strong contenders this year in particular, so everyone's really hyped up~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmm—
Who is the Umamusume... you place your hopes on?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's true. Everyone has such incredible legs, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To be completely honest! Cesario is the one I have my eyes on!
That blazing fighting spirit of hers is just so awesome.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Because in the end, that fighting spirit to say 'I will win!' is what really counts!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
—Excuse me. I'd like to watch the race as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even her senior, the "Supreme Commander of Japan," Special Week, was there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And Symboli Kris S as well—a fellow senior and an international student from America.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A glamorous first act that left everyone floating on air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I boarded the Shinkansen with Cesario to head to the Hanshin Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By chance, I ran into Rhein Kraft, who was also heading toward Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Being able to go together feels like a good omen somehow~♪"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: All my nerves blew away! Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So you were nervous after all?
Craft was watching videos of the Oka Sho
until late last night, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. You figured it out, huh?
I mean, after all... it's the stage of my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ms. Mejiro Ramonu, Ms. Nishino Flower—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Still in Love-san.
Every upperclassman's 'Oka Sho'
was uniquely, breathtakingly beautiful...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Everyone had their own sparkle,
and even now, it hasn't faded one bit...
Yeah, it was truly incredible.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
It really is a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
............
I want to become like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who shines so brightly
that she leaves a lasting impression on someone like that...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Leaving it behind, passing it on, to someone's future—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, hehehe!
How many times have we had this conversation already?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Craft and I share similar dreams,
so I just can't help getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I wonder if we'll be talking like this during the Oaks too."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Mm, nope! It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly... the Oka Sho is finally here.
It's amazing, my dream has really come true."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'm truly happy to be running with you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a fair and square race today.
I'm counting on you, Rhein Kraft."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice to meet you, Cesario!
And you too, Cesario's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying two grand dreams,
the bullet train races toward the west.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now then, which bud will take center stage today—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Please watch my radiance!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That's my line!
Today, I'll catch you for sure!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother's wishes... I will definitely carry them through!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The first coronet, paving the way to a distant future—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I will bring it home without fail.
Just watch me, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the curtain rises.
